notes.title: Multiplayer Level Update
notes.notes: New multiplayer level update includes new tunnel  feature with stairway leading to roof to get the upper hand as you battle through the streets. or fancy a change of scenery entre the club where you can go out side for a element of surprise. You can now smash windows and have a good old bar battle.

notes.title: Alien Street Battle biggest update
notes.notes: New updates to alien street battle include bigger open world more room to room new motorbike racing mission race against alien vehicle enter clothes shop try on new clothes for size new tips and tricks teach you all the new game content also added alien character updates bringing aliens to life alien street battle is a on going project built by a single developer and will have a lot more content to come I will be fixing them enjoying bugs and glitches adding new missions smoother gameplay the list never ends thank you to all players of my game and feedback every comment counts
